summary: Validator requires 5 repository artifacts under the refactor-acceptance skill; runs 6 registered Python/test/package-validation commands from repository root; missing artifacts yield failure family implementation-not-present with no authorization; any nonzero command yields registered-command-failed with recent output and no authorization; all commands passing yields schema jimuyun.refactor-acceptance-toolchain-implementation-validation.v1, predicate implementation-complete, authorizes implementation-complete only; explicitly does not authorize acceptance-passed, release, or archived; uses Windows py -3 and a hardcoded Administrator skill-validator path
